parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm at about 70 bpm with normal PR interval, narrow QRS and normal R-wave progression; the mild J-point elevation with tall upright T waves in V2-V3 is a benign early-repolarization pattern with no reciprocal changes, so it does not meet STEMI criteria.
